findings.name: No authentication on remote MCP server
findings.evidence:
https://tensorfeed.ai/api/mcp -> HTTP 200
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":"391ef8b9-ee0a-4ae9-8acf-63197a65744e","result":{"tools":[{"name":"get_news_articles","description":"Get the latest AI news articles aggregated from 12+ sources (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, HuggingFace, TechCrunch, The Verge, Hacker News, etc). Polled every 10 min, deduplicated, sanitized for prompt injection. Returns up to 200 articles with title, snippet, source, and publish
findings.spec_reference: Transports §Security: servers SHOULD authenticate all connections. A protected server MUST answer 401 when authorization is required.
findings.notes: tools/list returned 32 tool(s) without any credential.

findings.name: Cleartext HTTP transport (no TLS)
findings.spec_reference: OAuth 2.1 §1.5 / MCP Authorization: auth-bearing traffic MUST use HTTPS (loopback exempt).

findings.name: 401 without RFC 9728 WWW-Authenticate pointer
findings.evidence:
https://tensorfeed.ai/api/mcp -> HTTP 200
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":"8354a3be-1a10-47f6-8536-0919c3dc8e50","result":{"tools":[{"name":"get_news_articles","description":"Get the latest AI news articles aggregated from 12+ sources (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, HuggingFace, TechCrunch, The Verge, Hacker News, etc). Polled every 10 min, deduplicated, sanitized for prompt injection. Returns up to 200 articles with title, snippet, source, and publish
findings.spec_reference: MCP Authorization 2025-06-18: on 401 the server MUST return WWW-Authenticate indicating the protected-resource-metadata URL (RFC 9728 §5.1).
findings.notes: Server did not issue a 401/403, so the WWW-Authenticate MUST is not triggered (see no-authentication-remote for the real risk).

findings.name: Missing OAuth Protected Resource Metadata (RFC 9728)
findings.evidence:
https://tensorfeed.ai/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource -> HTTP 404
<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="en"><head><meta charSet="utf-8"/><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"/><link rel="preload" as="image" href="/tensorfeed-icon.png" fetchPriority="high"/><link rel="stylesheet" href="/_next/static/css/e0ccaeebc0ba21a8.css" data-precedence="next"/><link rel="preload" as="script" fetchPriority="low" href="/_next/static/chunks/webpack-d7c65cd43f
findings.spec_reference: MCP Authorization 2025-06-18: servers MUST expose RFC 9728 metadata at /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource including authorization_servers.
findings.notes: No metadata doc; server negotiated <2025-06-18 where 9728 is not a MUST.

findings.name: Session identifier carried in URL/query string
findings.evidence:
https://tensorfeed.ai/api/mcp -> HTTP 200
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":"327fb14d-953e-48fc-8a70-7da437a77e76","result":{"protocolVersion":"2024-11-05","capabilities":{"tools":{}},"serverInfo":{"name":"tensorfeed","version":"1.36.2"},"instructions":"TensorFeed.ai MCP server. Hosted HTTP transport at https://tensorfeed.ai/api/mcp serves a curated subset of 32 tools; the full 24-tool set ships on the npx stdio server @tensorfeed/mcp-server. Free ti
findings.spec_reference: OAuth 2.1 §5: tokens MUST NOT appear in URI query. MCP Streamable HTTP moved the session to the Mcp-Session-Id header.
findings.notes: No header session id and no URL-borne session id observed.
